channel.description: Resources Slides Video Script 00:00 Hello and welcome to the week two announcements for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2026. So hopefully you’re getting started working on Lab 1. Lab 1 is going to be due, I believe, next week sometime. So make sure you’re getting that worked on. For grading in this class, we do, for a lot of these labs, we’re going to do an in-person grading via Zoom. So the way this works is to get your lab graded. You schedule a time slot via our Calendly links. Please look at Sicheng’s Calendly link first than mine. I will get Sicheng’s posted later today so that it’s on the syllabus and on the homepage. If Sicheng is available, I’d prefer that you schedule with Sicheng first. If not, feel free to schedule with me. What you’re going to do is you’re going to make snapshots of your VMs and have those booted and ready to go when you connect to the Zoom. And then I or Sicheng is going to walk you through the things that we need to see on the rubric. You should know how to show us those things. So if we ask you, show us how all the user accounts that you created or show us that this user account is in this group or show us the permissions for these files, you should know how to do that. The lab has all of that in there.
